subject: general
question: The Vedangas are Hindu auxiliary disciplines that originated in ancient times and are linked to the study of the Vedas. These are _______ in number.
solution:
The correct answer is __**six**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Vedangas are six auxiliary disciplines associated with the study of the Vedas.
 
• They were developed in ancient India to support the proper understanding and interpretation of the Vedas.
 
• The six Vedangas are: Shiksha (Phonetics), Vyakarana (Grammar), Chandas (Meter), Nirukta (Etymology), Jyotisha (Astronomy), and Kalpa (Rituals).
 
• Each Vedanga serves a specific purpose in ensuring the accurate preservation, recitation, and understanding of the Vedic texts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shiksha (Phonetics)**

 
 
• Shiksha deals with the sounds of the Sanskrit language, including the rules of pronunciation, accent, and intonation.
 
• It is essential for maintaining the oral tradition of the Vedas by ensuring accurate and consistent recitation.
 
 
 
• **Vyakarana (Grammar)**
 
 
• Vyakarana is the study of Sanskrit grammar and linguistic analysis.
 
• The most famous text of Vyakarana is Panini's Ashtadhyayi, which codifies the rules of Sanskrit grammar.
 
 
 
• **Chandas (**M**etrics****)**
 
 
• Chandas is the study of poetic meters used in Vedic texts.
 
• It helps in understanding the structure and rhythmic patterns of Vedic hymns.
 
 
 
• **Nirukta (Etymology)**
 
 
• Nirukta involves the interpretation and explanation of difficult Vedic words.
 
• Yaska's Nirukta is a significant work in this field, providing meanings and contexts of Vedic terms.
 
 
 
• **Jyotisha (Astronomy)**
 
 
• Jyotisha is the study of astronomy and astrology as related to Vedic rituals.
 
• It includes the calculation of auspicious times (muhurta) for performing Vedic rituals.
 
 
 
• **Kalpa (Rituals)**
 
 
• Kalpa deals with the procedures and rituals of Vedic ceremonies.
 
• It includes various texts like the Shrauta Sutras, Grihya Sutras, and Dharma Sutras, which guide the performance of Vedic rituals.
